# #866 review: preparation.json re-pin

**Verdict: CLEAR.** Reviewed main HEAD 815416027fc23a69e1210189064b562de36482fe. The correction commit is f8670d527fc50aea3c097d92de01d9d752375610 (#865).

- sha256 of `benchmark/preparation.json`: e304aff09d543e07967999662da19002abf0adf40a9400a5ad98288d1fa3063d (measured with `python3 -B`).
- sha256 of `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`: 8e919d489ae835c59ae6c566ce2aa4a9300e235f4a378d04c763dbc011cca975 (measured with `python3 -B`).
- All 62 entries of `protected_inputs_sha256` were recomputed against disk. There were no mismatches.
- `git show --stat` of f8670d5 shows one file changed, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` (1 insertion, 1 deletion).
- I grepped for `99069d8d` and `5b06e263` with an independent os.walk. Every hit is historical, and I agree with the reasons:
  - task and staging text (`.session/issue.md`, the staged classification);
  - `iterations/0201/tasks.json`, `journal/working-memory.md` and `policy/working-memory.md`;
  - archived session-report bodies.
- There is no hit in `benchmark/**` or in any live pin file.

## Standards
No findings.

## Spec
All five acceptance items are met.

## Discoveries
- The staged classification does not list `session-reports/865/*.json`, which also contains the old prefixes. It is historical, so this is a minor omission.
- The classification cites `.session/history/sessions/861/...md:38,:50`. My walk found no hit there, so I could not confirm that entry. It would be historical either way.
- I read only the stat of f8670d5, not its diff body. All 62 pins match disk, which covers the changed line.

Evidence is in `.session/artifacts/review.md`. I made no repository writes and make no claim about LabVIEW behaviour.
